$doc: Dagr section 02, the friction moment: the convoy cinemagraph that replaced the three beat figures (ruling M2, 5 Oct 2026). Manifest for ConvoyMoment.tsx, which binds it to the generic FrictionMoment (components/friction-moment.tsx). Seven RGBA PNGs, black ink on transparent, copied unchanged from the test page assets: one 1600x1073 base and, per vehicle, an ink sprite and a mask of the same size. Every src is here so lint:assets checks it against git.
$boxDoc: box is the vehicle's END position, in percent of the stage: left and width of the stage width, top and height of the stage height. Each width x 1600 and height x 1073 lands on the sprite's own pixel size (v1 379.7 x 389.1 against 380 x 389), so the sprite renders at its drawn size at a 1600px stage. The loop's start offset (+6.5% left, -3.83% top) lives in the CSS keyframes, not here.
$maskDoc: The mask is the vehicle's silhouette. FrictionMoment paints a --bg-canvas knockout through it under the ink, so the base's contour lines do not show through the moving vehicle. It is never shown itself, so it does not invert in dark mode; the knockout follows the canvas token instead.
label: A convoy of three military vehicles, one carrying a radar dish, moves across a contour map. Behind them a single push pin is still stuck in the empty ground where they used to be.
